title: Catch-Up Installment Charges on Reinstated TRICARE Prime Enrollments
content:
A fee-bearing **TRICARE Prime** enrollment that an Enrollment Reinstatement Review brought back after a nonpayment disenrollment can hold months of restored coverage that carry no installment charge; the catch-up installment is the charge for those months. No catch-up is charged on an enrollment that took effect in the current plan year.

## What posting the catch-up does

- One installment charge is added to the enrollment's fee account, with the coverage period and the amount given.
- The charge takes the installment frequency of the enrollment's payment arrangement and today's posting date.
- The enrollment's fee balance owed rises by the amount, and the new charge shows on the fee account as an open installment.

## Invocation

The tool is `post_catch_up_installment_4baf2609`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it for the verified caller.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `prime_enrollment_id` | the reference number of the fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment the catch-up is billed to, read from the Prime enrollment lookup for the beneficiary | identifier, as returned |
| `coverage_period_start` | the first day of the first month the catch-up bills | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `coverage_period_end` | the last day of the last month the catch-up bills | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount` | the catch-up charge | US dollars, a plain number with 2 decimal places (cents, rounded half up), 0.00 or more |

## Return

On success the tool returns `posted` (true when the charge was added), `prime_fee_entry_id` (the new charge's reference number, beginning "pfc"), `prime_enrollment_id`, `coverage_period_start` and `coverage_period_end` as charged, `installment_frequency` (monthly, quarterly or annual, copied from the enrollment's payment arrangement), `amount` (USD, 2 decimals) and `fee_balance_due` (the enrollment's fee balance owed after the charge, USD, 2 decimals; a negative figure is a credit owed to the beneficiary). No other outcome is defined.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with a coverage period of 2026-04-01 to 2026-07-31 and an amount of 130.04 on an enrollment whose balance owed was 0.00 returns `posted` true, the frequency of the enrollment's arrangement, and a balance owed of 130.04.
